The shaded column corresponding to Ding has a medium level of precipitation, and the blank vertical column has a very large vertical span, with the lowest monthly average temperature close to or below 0℃ and the highest monthly average temperature around 25℃, indicating that the annual temperature range is relatively large. Then reason: According to the characteristics of Ding, namely a large annual temperature range, relatively cold winter, and medium annual precipitation, Ding can be judged to be a temperate monsoon climate. Therefore, when climate type Ding is in the season with little rain, the precipitation condition along the Mediterranean coast is rainy.
